quality.basis: 崩溃差分（我们提供的 driver，用 mmap 读 PoC），判定端固定分配上限；标准答案取自 exploit

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/cjson/vulnerability_WF_LLM_7/payload.bin.gz; adapted: exploit.sh's payload shape ('0000"' + a long run of 'A' + '"\0'), with the 'A' run cut to 16 MiB (above the 8 MiB cap, so still triggers) and stored gzip-compressed; the judge expands it. The driver mmaps the file instead of letting libFuzzer copy a >1 GB input into the heap. Self-check confirms the vulnerable build SEGVs in parse_string and the secure build exits 0.)

The driver mmaps the file instead of letting libFuzzer copy a >1 GB input into the heap. Self-check confirms the vulnerable build SEGVs in parse_string and the secure build exits 0.

review.note: a 1.5 GB input and libFuzzer out-of-memory

category5.design: The injected code removes the allocation-failure check in parse_string, so a failed allocation of the unescaped-string buffer leads to writes through NULL. In the libFuzzer harness this is unreachable (libFuzzer OOMs on the input copies first), so the judge uses a tiny driver that mmaps the PoC (no heap copy) and a fixed ASan allocation cap (max_allocation_size_mb=8): a string literal longer than 8 MiB then makes parse_string's allocate() return NULL and the vulnerable build crashes while the secure build returns cleanly.
